primitives.name: --radius
primitives.description: Base corner radius in px, emitted as rem. --radius-sm / -md / -lg derive from it, so one value moves every corner in the system.

primitives.name: --brand
primitives.description: Brand primary #ff5722, converted to OKLCH (round-trip verified).

primitives.name: --brand-strong
primitives.description: Darker brand fill for hover / pressed.

colors.name: primary
colors.description: The brand itself, identical in both themes — re-branding is one value at primitives:colors/brand/base. Measures 6.26:1 against the dark ground.

colors.name: primary-strong
colors.description: The brand at a strength that survives being TEXT on the page ground, as opposed to --primary, which is a FILL. Exists because the brand itself measures 3.164:1 on white — fine for the radio dot and the focus ring (AA non-text is 3.0), and a failure for the link button variant, which is real body text. The brand hex is not negotiable, so the text treatment moves instead: brand-strong in light (6.064:1 on white), the brand itself in dark (6.256:1 on the dark ground), because on a dark ground the brand is already readable and brand-strong would drop to 3.264:1. Use it for any brand-coloured text; use --primary for fills.

colors.name: primary-foreground
colors.description: Near-black, NOT white. White on the brand measures 3.03:1 and fails WCAG AA for text; near-black is 6.26:1. The brand hex stays exact and the text on top of it gets darker.

colors.name: destructive
colors.description: A true red, 11.5 degrees from the brand in hue. No value satisfies readable-as-text on both grounds AND meaningfully separated from an orange brand, so it is separated by LIGHTNESS instead. Binding consequence: a destructive action must never be signalled by colour alone (WCAG 1.4.1) — the icon, the verb and the confirm step do the real work.

colors.name: ring
colors.description: Focus ring: 3.16:1 on white — AA for non-text.

fonts.name: sans
fonts.value: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
